description: We’re building an Earth Jukebox that turns NASA Earth data into dynamic sound, making Earth science more accessible, engaging, and immersive. We’re looking for teammates interested in software, web development, data analysis, Earth science, data visualization, UI/UX, audio, AI/ML, design, and storytelling. Beginners and creative learners are welcome!
summary: TERRA-SONIC: The NASA Earth Information Jukebox is a browser-based scientific acoustic workstation that translates authentic NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) visualizations into real-time, musically structured, Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) accessible soundscapes. Using client-side Computer Vision (HTML5 Canvas getImageData) across 24 bundled frames from 9 official NASA Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS) datasets plus the Caldwell 73 reference—alongside live SVS URL proxying and local image/video ingestion—TERRA-SONIC extracts optical luminance, RGB species distributions, contrast energy, pixel density, transient peaks, and projection-aware geographic sectors. These features drive a 100% procedural 4-bus Web Audio API synthesizer (Melodic Lead, 3-Voice Harmonic Pad, Kinetic Pulse, and Atmospheric Texture with phenomenon-specific audio cues) quantized to harmonic scales. Designed BLV-first, it features a WAI-ARIA 8x6 roving-focus tactile matrix, 3D stereo panning, anti-spam Web Speech narration, High-Contrast mode, DELTA A/B split-screen comparison, a 4-Chapter Story Tour, and lossless .WAV + SI-disclosure .JSON export.
details:
WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

TERRA-SONIC transforms NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) imagery into real-time musical telemetry so anyone—including Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) researchers, students, and citizens—can explore planetary change through sound.

1. NASA SVS Data & Proxy Pipeline:

- Includes 24 verified high-resolution frames across all 9 official EIC datasets (#5313 Night Lights, #3912 Sea Surface Currents & Temperature, #5669 GEOS Aerosols, #5533 Air Quality Models, #5425 Perpetual Ocean 2, #5196 DYAMOND CO2, #5011 ISS Lightning, #4960 3D Atmospheric River, #4950 GEDI Forest Height) plus #13786 Caldwell 73 calibration reference.

- Includes a Next.js server-side metadata fetcher (/api/svs/[id]) and strict HTTPS allowlisted CORS proxy (/api/svs/proxy) for https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/* assets, plus local PNG/JPG/MP4/WebM ingestion in Custom Ingest.

2. Real-Time Computer Vision (HTML5 Canvas getImageData):

- Supports 4 scan modes (Horizontal, Vertical, Radar, and interactive Probe reticle) across a 720x420 analysis buffer.

- Computes Rec. 709 optical luminance, RGB channel means, contrast energy, active pixel density, transient spikes, 3D stereo azimuth pan (-1 to +1), elevation (South-to-North), and 32-band spectral column profiles.

- Applies radiometric calibration: automatic white-margin absorption inversion for SVS #5533 multi-pollutant strips and vegetation-vs-ocean separation for SVS #4950 GEDI forest canopy. All unit estimates (°C, AOD, µg/m³, m/s, ppm, kg/m/s, m) are transparently labeled as color-derived approximations.

- Supports DELTA A/B split-screen comparison to hear and quantify real-time baseline vs. target differences right at the scanline.

3. 100% Original 4-Bus Procedural Web Audio DSP:

- Uses zero third-party or copyrighted audio samples. Every note is synthesized in real time via Web Audio API oscillators, biquad filters, stereo panners, noise buffers, and a DynamicsCompressor limiter.

- Quantizes visual energy into Pentatonic, Lydian, Dorian, Harmonic Minor, or Scientific Chromatic scales across 4 mixable stems (Melody Lead, 3-Voice Harmonic Pad, Kinetic Pulse, Atmospheric Noise) plus dataset-specific phenomenon layers (ISS thunder sub-drops, aerosol Geiger clicks, ocean swells, canopy plucks).

- Exports 16-bit Stereo PCM .WAV soundscapes paired with .JSON telemetry and Super Intelligence (SI) disclosure metadata.

4. Blind & Low-Vision (BLV) Accessibility & Story Tour:

- WAI-ARIA 8x6 Tactile Coordinate Matrix (48 sectors) with roving tabIndex Arrow-key navigation, 3D stereo audio probes, aria-live="polite" updates, non-spamming Web Speech API narration ([N] / [S]), WCAG AAA High-Contrast mode ([H]), and a 4-Chapter Guided Earth Story Tour ([T]).

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

- Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4

- HTML5 Canvas 2D API, W3C Web Audio API, Web Speech API (speechSynthesis)

- Deployed on Vercel with source hosted at https://github.com/codedbyasim/terra-sonic-earth-jukebox

CREATIVITY, FACTORS CONSIDERED & INTENDED IMPACT

- Decoupled 60 FPS Canvas/Audio loop from 10 Hz throttled React UI updates so DOM rendering never introduces audio jitter.

- Projection-aware coordinate engine distinguishes equirectangular maps, orthographic Earth globes (detecting off-disk space vacuum), multi-strip pollutant charts, regional grids, and star clusters.

- Empowers classrooms, science museums, and blind/low-vision learners worldwide to hear Earth data without paywalls, logins, or visual-only barriers.
